description: Deliberately valid and invalid data fixtures for the reference validator. Expected outcomes are assertions, not fabricated run results.

cases.name: missing-behavioral-test
cases.description: One selected UCS case has no directly linked behavioral test.

cases.name: duplicate-behavioral-test
cases.description: Two behavioral tests directly identify the same source case.

cases.name: duplicate-id
cases.description: An entity identity is declared twice.

cases.name: wrong-reference-kind
cases.description: An entity result points to a tool.

cases.name: uncovered-criterion
cases.description: The empty-list criterion has no applicable verification declaration.

cases.name: entity-revalidation
cases.description: A tool repeats canonical invariants on a ready entity.

cases.name: broken-graph
cases.description: An edge points outside the declared nodes.

cases.name: unsupported-profile
cases.description: This tool cannot interpret a different representation version.

cases.name: duplicate-yaml-key
cases.description: Duplicate keys are rejected before schema interpretation.

cases.name: unsafe-tag
cases.description: Explicit executable tags are rejected as data, never executed.

cases.name: draft-is-inconclusive
cases.description: A structurally valid draft does not claim a reviewed ADMV instance.

cases.name: legitimate-cycle
cases.description: An idempotent self-loop is valid, not an erroneous dependency cycle.

cases.name: observed-drift
cases.description: Changed source bytes preserve the intended record and produce a hash diagnostic.
